subject: Mutual action plan: evaluation dataset & prompt-pack exchange
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation materials exchange / next steps

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking a call earlier this week. Per our conversation, we want to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) in place to exchange a small evaluation slice (prompt pack + labelled samples) so your team can validate latency/cost and we can run a canary for model accuracy on your slices. High-level asks from BrightCart we noted: no redistribution, ephemeral access, and a destruction window after evaluation.

Proposed quick timeline:
- NDA (if needed) — sign by Nov 5
- Sample manifest + prompt pack (BrightCart -> Redwood) — deliver by Nov 10
- Canary test in Redwood sandbox (Redwood -> BrightCart results) — Nov 15–17
- Acceptance gate / feedback — Nov 22
- Full evaluation set (if accepted) — Nov 29

Usage constraints we suggest (draft):
- Evaluation-only license; no productization without separate agreement
- Retention: ephemeral cache only, max 30 days post-eval; no long-term storage
- Access: limited to named engineers on both sides; no downstream sharing

I attached our MAP template and a short prompt-pack sample license text to make review fast. If this looks right, happy to send a PDF MAP draft for signature and push the DocuSign link.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Partner Solutions (Redwood Inference)
--
Attachments: redwood_map_template.xlsx (stub), promptpack_sample_licenses.txt (stub)

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@brightcart.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation materials exchange / next steps

Irene —

Thanks, this looks like the right approach. Procurement looped in here to handle the NDA quickly. A couple quick clarifications before we sign off:
- Please include a destruction clause that requires confirmation of deletion (signed attestation) after the 30-day window.
- We need to validate that Redwood’s sandbox will not leak our customer PII; can you share the SOC 2 + data retention notes?

Attached is a small manifest (first 200 rows) that we can share now — it’s redacted for PII. We’ll follow up with the full prompt pack once procurement confirms the NDA.

Sara Patel
Head of ML Ops, BrightCart

Team —

FYI: BrightCart sent a small sample manifest and wants the attestation/destruction clause. Quick notes:
- Security: Karthik, can you confirm SOC2 + sandbox retention behavior and whether we can provide a signed deletion attestation template?

- Legal/contract: Monica, include the destruction attestation and a clause preventing model parameterization from their eval data.

I’m going to assemble a redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf and share with BrightCart.

—Irene

Sara / procurement —

Appended is a concise MAP draft and the sample prompt-pack license we discussed. Key milestones (editable):
1) NDA execution (DocuSign link) — target: COB Nov 5
2) BrightCart sample manifest + prompt pack (secure upload) — target: Nov 10
3) Redwood canary run in sandbox (Redwood engineers will execute) — Nov 15–18 (we added one extra day to accommodate timezone overlap)
4) Joint review & acceptance gate — Nov 22
5) If accepted: deliver the full evaluation set + close plan — Nov 29

Required compliance items (BrightCart):
- Signed NDA
- Short security questionnaire (we will provide SOC2 summary + retention notes)
- Named engineer list for access control

- License: evaluation-only, non-commercial, no model training or production use
- Retention: data cached for up to 30 days post-eval; deletion attestation to be signed within 7 days of deletion
- Access: limited to named engineers; no redistributions or downstream sharing

Attachments included: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf, promptpack_sample_licenses.txt
Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive?id=map-draft-BR215
